knob.background_degree.definition: Polynomial degree of Siril’s sky model at combine time; 2 for faint nebulae.
knob.background_degree.label: Background model degree

knob.background_sigma.definition: Rejects a frame whose background exceeds the night’s median by this many sigmas.
knob.background_sigma.label: Bright sky (σ)

knob.core_saturation_repair.definition: Rebuilds sensor-saturated cores from the unsaturated nights before stacking.
knob.core_saturation_repair.label: Repair saturated cores

knob.coverage_crop.definition: Cuts every channel to the field all of them cover.
knob.coverage_crop.label: Crop to the common field

knob.coverage_min_frac.definition: Fraction of the frames a region needs to count as covered.
knob.coverage_min_frac.label: Coverage threshold

knob.drop_wheel_transition.definition: Drops a filter run’s first frame when the wheel was still moving.
knob.drop_wheel_transition.label: Drop the filter-change frame

knob.edge_crop.definition: Trims the uneven stacking border off the channels before combining them.
knob.edge_crop.label: Crop the ragged edge

knob.flatten_background.definition: Removes each frame’s own gradient before a multi-night registration.
knob.flatten_background.label: Flatten each frame’s sky

knob.frame_review.definition: Pauses each lane after grading so you can keep or reject frames before the stack.
knob.frame_review.label: Review frames before stacking

knob.fwhm_sigma.definition: Rejects a frame whose FWHM exceeds the night’s median by this many sigmas.
knob.fwhm_sigma.label: Soft frame (σ)

knob.photometric_normalisation.definition: Maps every night onto the anchor night’s photometric scale before merging.
knob.photometric_normalisation.label: Match the nights’ brightness

knob.reference_breakpoint.definition: Pauses each lane once its frames are measured so you can pin the registration reference.
knob.reference_breakpoint.label: Choose the reference frame

knob.register_2pass.definition: Siril elects the best reference frame instead of the first one.
knob.register_2pass.label: Two-pass registration

knob.reject_trails.definition: Rejects a frame where the probe sees a satellite or plane trail.
knob.reject_trails.label: Reject trailed frames

knob.roundness_floor.definition: A frame whose stars are less round than this is always rejected (trailed guiding).
knob.roundness_floor.label: Roundness floor

knob.roundness_sigma.definition: Also rejects a frame whose roundness falls this many sigmas below the median.
knob.roundness_sigma.label: Elongated vs session (σ)

knob.scnr.definition: Siril rmgreen type: 0 average neutral, 1 maximum neutral, 2 maximum mask, 3 additive mask.
knob.scnr.label: Green removal type

knob.seam_noise_eq.definition: Evens out the noise depth where the night coverage changes.
knob.seam_noise_eq.label: Even the seam noise

knob.seam_offset_refit.definition: Refits each night’s sky offset on its overlap with the anchor night.
knob.seam_offset_refit.label: Refit the night seams

knob.stack_combine.definition: How the kept pixels are combined: the mean rejects, the others do not.
knob.stack_combine.label: Combination

knob.stack_combine.max.definition: Keeps the brightest value of each pixel (star trails).
knob.stack_combine.max.label: Maximum

knob.stack_combine.mean.definition: Average after rejection: the best signal to noise.
knob.stack_combine.mean.label: Mean

knob.stack_combine.median.definition: Median of each pixel: robust, but noisier than the mean.
knob.stack_combine.median.label: Median

knob.stack_combine.min.definition: Keeps the darkest value of each pixel.
knob.stack_combine.min.label: Minimum

knob.stack_fast_norm.definition: Estimates the normalisation faster, slightly less precisely.
knob.stack_fast_norm.label: Fast normalisation

knob.stack_feather.definition: Softens the stack’s edges over this many pixels; 0 keeps them hard.
knob.stack_feather.label: Feathering

knob.stack_norm.definition: How frames are matched to the reference before combining; additive and scaling by default.
knob.stack_norm.label: Normalisation

knob.stack_norm.addscale.definition: Matches the sky level and the spread.
knob.stack_norm.addscale.label: Additive with scaling

knob.stack_norm.auto.definition: Siril’s default: matches the sky level and the spread.
knob.stack_norm.auto.label: Additive + scaling

knob.stack_norm.mul.definition: Matches the scale only; the choice for flats.
knob.stack_norm.mul.label: Multiplicative

knob.stack_norm.mulscale.definition: Matches the scale and the spread.
knob.stack_norm.mulscale.label: Multiplicative with scaling

knob.stack_norm.none.definition: Frames are combined as they are.
knob.stack_norm.none.label: None

knob.stack_output_norm.definition: Scales the stacked master to the 0–1 range.
knob.stack_output_norm.label: Normalise the output

knob.stack_reject.definition: How outlier pixels (satellites, cosmic rays) are rejected while stacking; auto picks by frame count.
knob.stack_reject.label: Pixel rejection

knob.stack_reject.auto.definition: Percentile up to 7 frames, generalized ESD from 50, winsorized sigma in between.
knob.stack_reject.auto.label: Auto

knob.stack_reject.generalized.definition: Statistical outlier test; the most accurate from about 50 frames.
knob.stack_reject.generalized.label: Generalized ESD

knob.stack_reject.linear.definition: Fits a line per pixel across frames; good with gradients that change.
knob.stack_reject.linear.label: Linear fit clipping

knob.stack_reject.mad.definition: Sigma clipping on the median absolute deviation.
knob.stack_reject.mad.label: MAD clipping

knob.stack_reject.median.definition: Sigma clipping that replaces rejected pixels with the median.
knob.stack_reject.median.label: Median sigma clipping

knob.stack_reject.none.definition: Every pixel is averaged, outliers included.
knob.stack_reject.none.label: None

knob.stack_reject.percentile.definition: Rejects pixels far from the median by a fraction; suited to very few frames.
knob.stack_reject.percentile.label: Percentile clipping

knob.stack_reject.sigma.definition: Rejects pixels beyond the sigmas from the mean, iteratively.
knob.stack_reject.sigma.label: Sigma clipping

knob.stack_reject.winsorized.definition: Sigma clipping on winsorized statistics: robust from about 8 to 50 frames.
knob.stack_reject.winsorized.label: Winsorized sigma clipping

knob.stack_reject_high.definition: High parameter of the rejection (sigma or fraction); 0 takes the algorithm’s default.
knob.stack_reject_high.label: High rejection

knob.stack_reject_low.definition: Low parameter of the rejection (sigma or fraction); 0 takes the algorithm’s default.
knob.stack_reject_low.label: Low rejection

knob.stack_rejection_maps.definition: Also writes images of the pixels rejected low and high.
knob.stack_rejection_maps.label: Rejection maps

knob.stack_weight.definition: How each frame counts in the stack: sharper frames weigh more with wFWHM.
knob.stack_weight.label: Frame weighting

knob.stack_weight.nbstack.definition: Weights by how many frames each input already stacks.
knob.stack_weight.nbstack.label: Stacked count

knob.stack_weight.nbstars.definition: Weights by the number of stars detected.
knob.stack_weight.nbstars.label: Star count

knob.stack_weight.noise.definition: Weights by the inverse of each frame’s noise.
knob.stack_weight.noise.label: Noise

knob.stack_weight.none.definition: Every kept frame counts the same.
knob.stack_weight.none.label: Equal

knob.stack_weight.wfwhm.definition: Weights by star sharpness and count; the legacy default.
knob.stack_weight.wfwhm.label: Sharpness (wFWHM)

knob.star_count_frac.definition: Rejects a frame with fewer stars than this fraction of the median: likely clouds.
knob.star_count_frac.label: Clouds (star fraction)

knob.trail_downsample.definition: Pixel size of the image the trail probe looks at.
knob.trail_downsample.label: Trail probe size

knob.trail_mask_k.definition: Masks satellites and cosmic rays above this many sigmas across frames; 0 turns it off.
knob.trail_mask_k.label: Trail mask (σ)
